groups.saying_opens: كم من دار سكنها ناس فهلكوا
حصير في البيت خير من امرأة لا تلد

notes: Three sayings each with its own transmitters (rule 4a): the Prophet's saying, Malik's explanation read through Abu Dawud, and Umar's saying
«حمزة، وسالم، ابنى عبد الله بن عمر»: the apposition after سالم describes the two men and is left out of the surface
«وأنا شاهد» and «قرئ على» are the compiler's own statements, not links
«قال عمر» with no transmitter before him is a single-link group (rule 10)
